# Synthetic fixtures

Every file in this directory is mechanically generated by
`scripts/build_synthetic_fixtures.py`. The values are invented and do not
correspond to a real candidate, source occupation, job advertisement, pool,
prompt, or model response.

The fixtures exercise only approved structural invariants: the six profiles,
four architecture conditions, Top-6 and Top-10 ID constraints, a 60-job pool,
salary missingness/annualization examples, interaction direction, accounting
identity, and recommendation overlap by original job identity.

Only small, entirely synthetic fixtures may be stored here. Do not derive fixtures
by copying real résumés, names, telephone numbers, companies, job descriptions,
URLs, job IDs, or raw model responses.
